rows.method: implicit residual derivatives with analytic circulation columns

definitions.clamped: Solve only the saved circulation residual block with all non-Gamma increments fixed at zero.
definitions.elastic_difference: Saved coupled Gamma response minus clamped response; includes aerodynamic feedback, compliance and transfer changes.
definitions.output_remainder: Serialized full directional Cl derivative minus the zero-load linear reconstruction; retained explicitly.
definitions.cancellation: (absolute clamped Cl + absolute elastic-difference Cl) / absolute reconstructed full Cl; not a condition number.
definitions.zones: Interval-overlap allocation of integrated strip resultants; conservative bookkeeping, not exact subelement quadrature or an error-origin map.

limitations: Algebraic diagnostics of corrected captured discrete operators, not independent rigid-wing, continuum or experimental reference solutions.
Only Gamma columns are analytic; inherited non-Gamma/input/output finite-stencil approximations remain.
Both aerodynamic and structural grids change in the original mesh comparison; fixed local patch error is not bounded.
The elastic difference cannot be equated with structural discretization error.
Local section Mach is nonzero despite fixed PG Mach zero; no pressure-invariance acceptance gate.
Original two 1% mesh failures and all earlier verdicts stay unchanged. No new mesh acceptance or performance claim.

remaining: Check fixed-geometry aerodynamic discretization and load integration independently on the existing meshes.
Use a separately frozen common-load mechanical comparison to distinguish compliance and load transfer from aerodynamic feedback; the source plan has not been executed.
Establish global convergence and bound the fixed control-boundary patch error without changing the original tolerances.
Resolve experimental control amplitude/incidence/sign, section-control provenance and specimen/fixture correspondence; complete driven-roll and reversal comparisons.
